files.description: EHI Export User Guide (28 pages). The primary (b)(10) EHI export documentation. Contains a complete data dictionary for 22 CSV files (383 fields total) with column headings, SQL data types, and descriptions. Also documents the export ZIP structure including image folders, USCDI XML file, and Complete Patient Chart PDF. Dated November 2, 2023.

FHIR API Documentation Guide (76 pages). The (g)(10) FHIR R4 API documentation covering standard US Core resources (AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Goal, Immunization, Location, MedicationRequest, Observation, Organization, Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Procedure, Provenance). Separate from the EHI export but downloaded for context. Dated April 2024.

Screenshot of the expanded Certifications accordion section showing all documentation links including EHI EXPORT DOCUMENTATION, FHIR API DOCUMENTATION, API Terms of Use, CHPL Listing, Costs, and Real World Testing Plans/Results.
Screenshot showing the certifications section with the EHI export documentation link centered in view.

Structured JSON extraction of the complete EHI export data dictionary. Contains all 22 CSV file definitions with 383 fields, including column headings, SQL data types, and descriptions. Machine-queryable format for downstream analysis.
Bun TypeScript script that extracts the data dictionary from the EHI Export PDF (via pdftotext) into structured JSON. Reproducible enrichment pipeline.
Documentation for the enrichment pipeline: run commands, input/output descriptions, and known parsing limitations.
